suites.name: Quantum Gradient Invariance
suites.keyFinding: Oscillator-level gradient test: does sign(∇VarI1)→trend and |∇VarI1|→|VarI1| appear before boundary formation?

suites.name: Oscillator-to-Gravity Chain
suites.keyFinding: 5-level chain: Oscillator→Parametric→Boundary→Graph→Galactic. Traces gradient law through all transitions.

suites.name: Information Bottleneck Layer
suites.keyFinding: Transition analysis: paired comparisons at Param→Bound and Bound→Graph. Ranks bottlenecks by information loss.

suites.name: Boundary Emergence Strength
suites.keyFinding: Boundary vs discarded cell comparison. Tests if boundary extraction actively amplifies gradient, curvature, and coherence.

suites.name: Boundary Signal Concentration
suites.keyFinding: 4-zone analysis (boundary/near-1/near-2/interior) + random control. Tests 4 mechanisms: sign-geometry, curvature, compression, topology.

suites.name: Boundary Amplified Gravity
suites.keyFinding: Raw vs curvature-weighted gradients on SPARC. Tests if boundary amplification improves galactic predictions.

suites.name: Amplitude Gradient Exponent
suites.keyFinding: Four candidate models (linear, sqrt, power, log) fitted. Bootstrap stability. Best-fit α determined.

suites.name: Residual Power Law
suites.keyFinding: α fitted per population (BARYON/MIXED/DM/LSB/HSB). CI overlap, pooled vs class-specific R². Universality test.

suites.name: Tick Gradient Origin
suites.keyFinding: Causal direction test: Tick→Gradient vs Gradient→Tick. ∇Tick vs ∇|m| correlation, peak alignment, reconstruction.

suites.name: Feedback Gradient Origin
suites.keyFinding: ∇fb as primitive source. ∇fb→∇|m| correlation, boundary selection, reconstruction, primitive source ranking.

suites.name: Feedback Birth Theorem
suites.keyFinding: Deeper origin: does fb emerge from oscillator mismatch? fb↔|m| correlation, reconstruction without fb, causal chains.

suites.name: Tick Geometry Resonance
suites.keyFinding: Feedback loop test: Geometry→Tick? Tick→∇fb? 4 loop signals, closed-loop evidence assessment.

suites.name: Resonance Loop Stability
suites.keyFinding: Loop gain G = G1×G2×G3×G4. Quantifies amplification/damping. Saturation and attractor analysis.
